## {.bare background-color="#0b0b0b"}

::: {.big}
<span id="num">CHF 0</span>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Pattern for an animation that also prints: the final state is in the HTML,
// the script only animates towards it when the slide is entered on screen.
(function () {
  const el = document.getElementById("num");
  const target = 35452000.5;
  const fmt = (v) => "CHF " + v.toLocaleString("de-CH", {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  el.textContent = fmt(target);
  const isPrint = /print-pdf/.test(location.search);
  function run() {
    if (isPrint) return;
    const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 1800;
    (function tick(now) {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4);
      el.textContent = fmt(target * e);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    })(t0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", (ev) => { if (ev.currentSlide.contains(el)) run(); });
    Reveal.on("ready", (ev) => { if (ev.currentSlide.contains(el)) run(); });
  });
})();
</script>
```
